content.thinking: I found two issues: the retired 5900 account is still in use with memos noting "charge to 5300 Facilities," and VEND_CD is only length 5 despite the dictionary's 8-char padding, with INV_NO already embedding the vendor code. Next I'll check the SRC_REF format, how invoice numbers are built, and the pay and invoice journals.

input.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", '['||i."VEND_CD"||']' vc, octet_length(i."VEND_CD") ol, i."INV_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", i."INV_DT", h."POST_DT" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (1,2,509,803) OR i."INV_NO" LIKE '%CM'

SELECT 'gl_non_accrual' k, count(*)::text a, '' b FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' AND "MEMO"<>'Manual accrual' 
UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_accrual_pairs', "JRNL_NO"::text, "POST_DT"::text||' '||coalesce("REF_JRNL_NO"::text,'-') FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' AND ("MEMO" LIKE 'Manual%' OR "MEMO" LIKE 'Reversal%') ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 12

SELECT 'accrual_unreversed' k, count(*)::text a FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."MEMO"='Manual accrual' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" r WHERE r."REF_JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_same_user_posted_period_closed', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT">p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_open_in_closed', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" WHERE "STAT_CD"='O'
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_unposted', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "POST_FLG"<>'P'
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_gl_amt_mismatch', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT sum(l."CR_AMT"-l."DR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD"='2000    ')
UNION ALL SELECT 'ln_seq_dups', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO","LN_SEQ" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
